Backend: 9/9 pytest green (text index on db.memory named 'memory_fulltext' exists; recall returns normalized scores in [0,1]; short/empty query fallback works; TokenStreamed events emitted for research (326) and verification (347) loops on sess_2b8612b152 in addition to planner (198); /api/sessions/{sid}/tree returns 59-node tree with kinds search/extract/verify/synthesize/iteration/fact/entity/gap and 404 for unknown session; rehydrate top-up confirmed by inserting 2 events with higher seq directly into db.events — subsequent GET /events returned them). Frontend: /runtime/sess_2b8612b152 loads, all 6 tabs (plan/tree/knowledge/confidence/skill/replay) render, Reasoning tab shows 'Reasoning Tree · 59 nodes · depth 3', 23 confidence pills on fact nodes, structure sidebar (leaves 53, depth 3) and full legend (SEARCH/EXTRACT/VERIFY/SYNTH/ITER/FACT/ENT/GAP) render, chevron collapse 59→1 and re-expand 1→59 work with framer-motion layout animation, no errors when cycling through the other 5 tabs.

issues: Root node has no 'kind' field in runtime.py so the row's data-testid renders as 'tree-row-undefined' (cosmetic — functionality unaffected; consider seeding session.reasoning_tree with kind='root' in Session.__init__).

action_items: Optional cosmetic: set session.reasoning_tree kind='root' in runtime.py Session.__init__ so the top row renders data-testid="tree-row-root" instead of tree-row-undefined (matches KIND_META.root icon/color).
critical_code_review_comments: memory.py:69-93 — text-index recall + fallback layered cleanly. Max-normalization to [0,1] via `mx = max(scores)` is correct and stable. The `filter_['session_id'] = {'$ne': exclude_session}` on the $text query works because Mongo lets you combine $text with other filters in the same $and.

eventbus.py:72-94 — rehydrate(force=False) correctly checks `buf_len >= mongo_count` before short-circuiting and rebuilds the buffer from scratch when Mongo has more. However, the top-up replaces the buffer with the sorted Mongo docs; any in-memory-only events not yet persisted (during a brief race window) will not be preserved. In practice fine because emit() writes to Mongo synchronously in the same coroutine before returning.

runtime.py:178-211 — _stream_json emits TokenStreamed only when buffer of last 6 tokens > 24 chars, so token bursts are naturally batched. Fallback on stream failure → chat_json → JSON substring extraction → final chat_json retry is robust. Extract/verify now flow through the same helper.

runtime.py:414-422 — research iteration node grafting: finds an existing 'search' child or creates one lazily; this means the first-time-through the reasoning tree grows a 'research' child at run-time even though the planner emits child tasks with kind='search' — verified in real session: root has both a task 'search' node and a synthesized research subtree. Consider unifying to avoid duplicate roots.
ReasoningTree.jsx:17-34 — walkFlat uses a stack instead of recursion so unbounded tree depth won't stack-overflow the browser. Good.
ArtifactCanvas.jsx:11-18 — new 'tree' tab added between Plan and Knowledge; tab-underline animation is shared across all tabs via `layoutId="tab-underline"` so switching feels smooth.
